feature: Persistent production/pilot Linux repositories and automatic GC

tasks.description: Specify production/pilot retention, lifecycle, contracts and validation
Implement locked persistent inventory, immutable import, native version retention and grace planning in release-cli/src/linux_repo_state.rs
Integrate state and automatic retention with publish-linux-repos CLI and staged signed repository publication
Verify origin metadata and add retryable, prefix-aware S3 and local package collection after successful publication
Exercise sequential product deployments, native ordering, dry run, grace, locking and failure recovery through Nix tests; run formatting and Clippy
Document bootstrap, backups, sole publishing host, automatic collection and sibling pilot-package naming contract

validation: 2026-11-04 review follow-up: sandboxed Nix drt build passed 45 unit tests and one signing CLI integration test; one existing privileged pacman test ignored. Nix Clippy passed with warnings denied. Both macOS architectures evaluate drt and ops/release-cli shells. Signing fixtures verify APT/YUM signatures, export only the selected key from a multi-key keyring and reject non-IOHK production keys. Empty-directory dry-run and metadata-derived Flight signing regressions passed. See retention-plan.md and shared packaging validation for package checks. No live deployment.
